name: UEarnPool credits one stake as team volume to every upline
summary: UEarnPool.stake() added the full stake to the team volume of each referrer up the invite chain, and claimTeamReward() paid fixed per-level bonuses once that volume reached each level, so the attacker staked through a chain of self-referring contracts and had each one claim every level's bonus from the pool's USDT, 61 days after deployment.
